item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena is helping her grandmother in the kitchen. She pushes a heavy steel cupboard to make space near the wall, and the cupboard slides across the floor.
Which statement correctly identifies a force and the two interacting objects?

options.A: Meena's push on the cupboard is a force; the interacting objects are Meena and the cupboard.
options.B: The cupboard sliding on the floor is a force; the interacting objects are the cupboard and the wall.
options.C: The heavy weight of the cupboard is not a force, so no objects are interacting.
options.D: Any movement is a force, so the floor alone applies a force to itself.
